entry.notRun: startGit/startGitSync get a scripted spawn function; git is run for real only in the two real-install cases
entry.runs: src/runtime/shared/git-launch.mjs (resolveGitLaunch with an explicit platform and PATH, gitLaunchEnvironment, gitCommand, gitChildEnv, startGit, startGitSync) and git-runner.mjs runGitOffThread over trees of empty files in a temp folder

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

replay.entry: mixdog-scm git_launch.rs: rebuild each case's tree (files list) in a temp root and compare resolutions, environments, spawned-command sequences and retry counts whole (paths relative to <root>)

normalised.tempRoots: every temp root is <root>; a scripted-spawn case records commands relative to <root>

replay.platform: recorded on win32 (the Node tests that skip elsewhere ran); the cases that need no Windows layout also run elsewhere
